# Errors

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:reference` from `ERROR_HELP` in packages/core/src/errors.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Clients branch on `code`, never on `message`.

| Exit | Code | Meaning | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | `validation_failed` | A flag, argument or value is missing, unknown or invalid, or Jira rejected the input. | Read the message, correct the command and run it again. `jm <command> --help` lists the flags. |
| 3 | `not_found` | The issue, comment, worklog, link, attachment, sprint, view or timer does not exist. | Check the key or id. `jm <noun> list` shows what exists. |
| 4 | `permission_denied` | Jira refused the credentials, or no one is logged in. | Run `jm auth login`, or ask a Jira admin for access to the project. |
| 5 | `jira_error` | Jira failed or sent a response the CLI cannot read, after the CLI retried. | Try again later. A write may have gone through, so read the issue before repeating it. |
| 1 | `internal` | A bug in jm. | Run again with `JM_DEBUG=1` for the stack and report it. |
